metadata.question: Did Sacramento, California experience 2-meter air temperatures above 110 degrees fahrenheit in September 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Sacramento, California (approximately 38.58°N, -121.49°W) - Time: September 2022 (2022-09-01 to 2022-09-30) - Collection: ERA5-Land or ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY for 2-meter air temperature - Band: 'temperature_2m' (in Kelvin, need to convert to Fahrenheit) 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for ERA5 reanalysis data (it's modeled data, not satellite imagery) - Just need to check if maximum temperature exceeded 110°F (316.48K) 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Valid result: Temperature values in reasonable range (e.g., 250K-330K or -9°F to 134°F) - C1: No images in collection - C2: Not applicable (ERA5 has global coverage) - C3: Result is None/NaN or unreasonable (e.g., <200K or >350K) - A: If max temp > 110°F - B: If max temp <= 110°F ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const sacramento = ee.Geometry.Point([-121.49, 38.58]); const startDate = '2022-09-01'; const endDate = '2022-09-30'; // 2. Data Acquisition const era5 = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(sacramento) .select('temperature_2m'); const collectionSize = era5.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Collection size: ${collectionSize} images`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("No data found for September 2022."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Calculate maximum temperature const maxTemp = era5.max(); // 4. Extract value at Sacramento const result = maxTemp.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.max(), geometry: sacramento, scale: 11132, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const tempKelvin = result.get('temperature_2m').getInfo(); // 5. Validation & Conversion if (tempKelvin === null || tempKelvin === undefined || isNaN(tempKelvin)) { console.log("Calculation failed: Invalid temperature value"); console.log("C3"); return; } // Check if temperature is in reasonable range (200K to 350K) if (tempKelvin < 200 || tempKelvin > 350) { console.log(`Unreasonable temperature: ${tempKelvin}K`); console.log("C3"); return; } // Convert Kelvin to Fahrenheit: F = (K - 273.15) * 9/5 + 32 const tempFahrenheit = (tempKelvin - 273.15) * 9/5 + 32; console.log(`Max temperature in Sep 2022: ${tempFahrenheit.toFixed(2)}°F (${tempKelvin.toFixed(2)}K)`); console.log(`Images analyzed: ${collectionSize}`); // 6. Final Answer if (tempFahrenheit > 110) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
